precision_probe.definition: |F(x + h u) - F(x - h u)| / (2h) at states after 32 steps (prompt 0, start ' the'); relative deviation from the h = 1e-5 value; repeat_diff = max |F(x) - F(x)| between two batch positions

calibration.definition: sigma_T: mean over the development reference attractor states at T of KL(p_ref || softmax((z_ref + sigma_T b_p)/T)) equals the mean KL(p_ref || p_q8) at those states; z_ref stored in float32 for the bisection, KL in float64
